title: Little Boy in Shorts, Tree Shadow Yard - Vintage 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A charming mid-century black and white snapshot of a young boy posing outdoors in bright sunlight. Dressed neatly in a collared short-sleeve shirt, tailored dark shorts, white ankle socks, and dark shoes, he stands beside a rubber tree or tropical ficus plant in front of a stucco building. The strong sunlight casts intricate branch shadows against the wall behind him. The photograph reflects the quintessential optimism and suburban family life of the postwar American boom.
